about: The twelve lines of the Capture Router design page (2026-10-22) with their expected routing, written by hand from SPEC 5.25 and the brief, run against eastwinds-slice.json with story year 2066 (CR-10). A cultural line's endYear is the stored value (the timeline end, 2100, for an open end). A section given as a list accepts either. A null categoryId means the category is left to choose. Where the router's answer differs from the brief's table, the brief's value is kept in briefSaid with the reason in note.

lines.text: Chinese people in San Francisco begin to say yee haw ironically starting around 2065
Teenagers in Jinan treat an American college degree as a joke by the 2070s
Mark moves to Seattle in 2061 for a job at a Compact logistics firm
Should Frank's church split over the Compact in 2075?
Chinese parents stop sending kids abroad after 2068

facts.note: The brief gives no age group. Parents and kids both match; the first named, the subject, wins.

lines.text: The Compact bans gas cars on coastal highways in 2068
Siyuan's temple starts hosting Compact officials for merit-making dinners in 2070
Dawn and Mark argue about whether to raise LiNa bilingual

facts.note: LiNa comes after the verb, so she is the object: a candidate, with no moment of her own.

lines.text: 望安 goes by 'Wanda' at school
The Mission district becomes mostly Compact bureaucrats by 2080
Sydney's husband is a Nevada state trooper
In 2063 the second crash hits. Qin's drone factory loses its export license. Xuan takes a Party job in Beijing, and the Li family apartment is sold.

facts.note: "crash" is a cue of one category only (Economy), so the category is filled and nothing needs judgment.
No year of its own: takes 2063 from the sentence before. "drone" sits inside the place name, so only Economy is cued; the section leads by too little for Route A.
